articles.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
articles.description: Israel's PM says its military will not pull-out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

articles.title: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan returning to Ireland in high-security operation
articles.description: The Irish Prison Service bought a bulletproof and bombproof van to transport the 49-year-old to court after his extradition from Dubai.

articles.title: Andy Burnham to embark on cost of living tour through the UK

articles.title: How weight-loss medication is changing relationships with alcohol
articles.description: Some people using weight-loss drugs say their cravings for alcohol disappeared or they felt nauseous when they drank.
